in_marathi.name: Ak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Aksh’, meaning ‘eye’ or ‘vision’. In Hindu mythology, Aksh is the divine eye that sees beyond the physical realm, symbolizing wisdom and insight. The name Ak signifies one who possesses the inner vision and understanding, making them radiant and imperishable.
